preregistered.written_before: the place-spec call was made, the site was searched, the plateau was cut, any planner was called or a part was instantiated. The nine bars are rounds/demo.json's own, copied byte for byte and unmoved. The five further expectations and every threshold they read against -- BELT_SHARE_TOLERANCE 0.05, RING_COVERAGE 0.6, CENTRED_TOLERANCE 4, PALETTES_STANDING_MIN 3, core water 0 columns -- and the search's new needs -- CORE_WATER_MAX_PCT 2.0, relief flat 0.25 / rolling 0.55 per block of footprint -- were registered in phases 1-4, before this run's spec call. The baseline these numbers move is out/demo/macro_measures.json: belt coverage 24.3%, palace 91.6 off the site centre, core water 15.3%, belt 148 wide on the west and 13 on the east.
preregistered.order: place_spec (one call) -> site_search -> site -> cache -> plateau -> plan (arithmetic at the place level; one call per compound and per district) -> circulation -> parts -> finish -> lint -> place_check -> readout, offline into a volume; then, once, write -> render against the server, the write taken from world.before-plateau.npz with a snapshot kept as the undo.
preregistered.input: one sentence, and nothing else; the spec, the site, the voice and the size are chosen from that sentence.

place_read.note:
ring walls nested closed loops, a gate on each ring and on an arterial, an arterial
crossing a ring only at a gate, the palace inside the innermost ring, every structure
inside the outermost one. Holds or does not.

walk_from_outdoors_pct.note:
interior floor walkable from outdoors over the whole place, walk-only, under walk model
6.

e002_from_the_lane.note: doors reachable on foot from the lane. 0 in rounds 10 and 11.

own_lint_errors.note:
the build family over every part's own ground. The bar is 0 and the spec's section 2
asks for no worse than 7.

instantiation.note:
per cent of the plan's leaves that stand. 100%. 98.4%. 'Stand' is the type's own answer,
not the program's.

structures.bar: within the scaled band the spec produced
structures.note: plot leaves that stand, against the band the spec produced from the sentence after A2's ceiling scaled it. The driver reads the lower end as one comparator and the place read holds the round to both.

hand_programs.note: programs in this build that are not an instance of a committed type. Every part is composed by place.instantiate_part from a file under types/. The eight types Part B names and the re-authorings Part C names are authored before the build, never during it.

site_chosen.note: the ground was chosen by the system and the record of why is on disk -- the top three candidates with their scores and every square the scan read or refused to read -- and this config names no site. 0 if a human wrote a coordinate.

tokens_whole_effort.note:
millions of true tokens over every model call this effort made, Part B included -- the
place spec call, the eight type authors, the re-authorings, the place-level planner, one
planner call per district and the judge -- as the isolated subagents reported them.

reported_no_bar.compound: the palace as planned: the ground the library sized for it and why, its rectangle on that ground, its parts, their types and sizes, and the three compound clauses of the place read
reported_no_bar.great_wall: the outermost ring's type and planned height against GREAT_WALL_HEIGHT
reported_no_bar.plan_levels: the place level, the compound level and one level per district: what each was asked, what it answered, and whether it was handed back
reported_no_bar.camera: how far outside the gate the arrival frame stands, and the height it was measured against
reported_no_bar.site: what a fresh search says now, and why, is site_search.fresh-refused.json
reported_no_bar.concentric: the five expectations of a concentric place, read by the `concentric` measure and reported clause by clause: the belt's share of the site against what the spec declared less BELT_SHARE_TOLERANCE (0.05); every ring covered by its districts at RING_COVERAGE (0.6) or more; the compound at the centre within CENTRED_TOLERANCE (4) blocks of the site centre; PALETTES_STANDING_MIN (3) or more distinct voices among the parts that stood; 0 columns of water under the compound in the built volume
reported_no_bar.layout: the arithmetic's record on plan.json: every ring's share asked and got, its inner and outer half-side, its least width and the insets it came from, its wall and height, its districts and their coverage, the axis side the gates stand on, and which rings were squeezed to give the others their least widths
reported_no_bar.site_search: the fresh search's record: which squares the cache held, which the region files gave, which this session made (named), what met the needs and what was chosen, with the flat/dry-core/green needs it was scored on
reported_no_bar.spec_call: what the fresh spec call wrote: its invariants paragraph, the rings it declared with their shares, walls and voices, and whether it wrote fewer walled rings than the invariants it listed -- reported, not patched

rules_held: no coordinates, sizes or voices in this config; the system chooses and the record shows why
no builder call in the build; every part is an instance of a committed type
no live write of the city; one server session writes and photographs the palace and the skyline only
no bar is moved; a miss is reported as a miss
a library defect any test finds is fixed in the library and its case is kept
findings are fixed at their root, never patched at the leaf; standing cards and frames stay byte-identical; no new lint check; thresholds registered before the number that tests them
the demo is the probe and the mechanism is general
the place level is laid out by arithmetic and no place-level planner is called; every planner call is isolated and blinded and its true tokens recorded
ground the search makes beyond the region files is counted, capped by max_new_squares, and every square of it is named in the record
preregistered.expectation: registered before the spec call: the nine bars as the demo registered them (place read 1, walkable >= 90, doors 0, own errors 0, instantiation >= 95, structures in band, hand programs 0, site chosen 1, tokens <= 6M) with the run's own budget at <= 1.5M tokens; and the concentric measure's five clauses all holding -- belt share >= declared - 0.05, every ring's coverage >= 0.6, the compound within 4 of the site centre, 3 or more palettes standing, 0 columns of core water. A miss is a miss. If the fresh spec call writes fewer walled rings than the invariants it listed, that is reported, not patched.
